answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the willow check immediately, the vine audit keeps the resolved set and the comet replay shows exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Copying the same citations across 88 aliases therefore pays the reading cost 88 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
